name: Postman Docs MCP Server
summary: The documentation MCP server Postman's own llms.txt points an AI client at, at learning.postman.com/_mcp/server. Keyless 2026-10-21: initialize 200 (serverInfo fern-docs-mcp-server 1.0.0), a sessionless tools/list 200 with exactly one tool, searchDocs, carrying readOnlyHint true, and a keyless tools/call answering 4,104 bytes of Postman documentation with source URLs. A stranger needs no account, no key and no session. The vendor's other hosted endpoint, mcp.postman.com, refuses the same request with 401.

payments.notes: 2026-10-21: nothing on this surface is priced, no request drew a 402, and the search answered a stranger for free. Postman the platform is sold by seat; this entry is the documentation server only, which asked for nothing.

agentAccess.notes: Keyless 2026-10-21 06:28:49Z to 06:28:50Z: initialize 200 (198 B), tools/list 200 (677 B, one tool) with NO session header because the server issued none, and tools/call searchDocs 200 (4,104 B of documentation with source URLs). No credential, no cookie, no payment.
